messages:
olivia: Quick sync — we need a final checklist for the Marketplace launch this Thu 9am PST. Items: press asset signoff, hardware partner SKU swap (NimbusEdge v2 -> v2.1), SI onboarding timeline, landing page variants, CDN cutover. Who's owning creative + press standby?

mike: I can take creative signoff. Need assets by Tue EOD. @liz can you confirm hero + mobile variants? :eyes:

liz: yup - I have two hero comps in Figma: /s/figma/redwood-marketplace-hero. Will update CTA variants by Monday. Expecting final copy from @sara.

sara: sending copy now — doing compact + long lead versions. will post in drive by 2026-11-26 15:00 PST. FYI we have embargo window 11/28 10:00 UTC.

chen: SI onboarding: Sigma Integrations ready for early access. They want a tenant sandbox and quickstart playbook. @anup can you provision sandbox and add Sigma to staging org?

anup: provisioning now. ETA sandbox by Wed 18:00 PST. I'll add Sigma users + shared runbook link.

mike: press standby list: PMs + @olivia + @liz for approvals. We should have a 30-min press queue on launch day — who's on call?

olivia: I'll take first 2 hours. @chen can you rotate to afternoon? Also need legal signoff on partner quotes.

deploy-bot: Staging cutover scheduled: 2026-11-28 02:30 UTC -> 03:00 UTC. Notifying infra. :robot_face:

chen: HW partner swap — NimbusEdge v2.1 uses different SKU id. @sara please update marketplace listing SKU and short spec blurb.

sara: will update SKU + specs in the listing doc and ping legal. Also adding compatibility note for quantized models.

mike: Landing page: two variants A/B test — hero focused vs. technical spec. @liz will wireframes support both? we need analytics tag ready.

liz: yes — will add analytics snippet and event names: marketplace_launch_cta, checkout_start.

olivia: OK — action items: mike (creative + press queue), liz (Figma + analytics), sara (copy + SKU update + legal ping), anup (sandbox + Sigma), chen (SI oncall rota). Everyone tag when done. Thanks! :tada:
